DEFINITION · qeva:1:definition@1

Definition

A definition fixes how a new expression is to be used in terms of already available structure.

editorialfoundations · logic
Trace this conceptSearch connections

PLAIN

The idea

A definition fixes how a new expression is to be used in terms of already available structure.

EXACT

The compact statement

A conservative explicit definition introduces a symbol d with a clause d(x) ↔ φ(x), where φ uses the prior language and uniqueness or admissibility conditions are stated when needed.

Example

‘n is even’ may be defined as ‘there exists k with n=2k’.

Boundary / caveat

Definitions can conceal existence, uniqueness, type, or context assumptions unless those are exposed.

Assumptions

  • The declared formal or mathematical discourse context is fixed.
